title: 🐶 Playful Labrador Mix Puppies Ready for Adoption in Madisonville - NewsBreak
text:
13 hours ago Two sweet Labrador Retriever mix puppies are waiting at the Hopkins County Humane Society in Madisonville, KY for their forever homes. These little ones are full of love and puppy energy — perfect for families ready to welcome a new furry friend.
Dolly Breed: Labrador Retriever / Mixed Breed (Medium)
Age: Baby
Gender: Female
Color: Black
Shelter: Hopkins County Humane Society
Phone: (270) 821-8965
Dolly is a young black Lab mix with a shiny coat and a curious spirit. She’s still a baby, so she’ll need a family ready to guide her through puppyhood with patience and love.
👉 Meet Dolly and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Dezzy Breed: Labrador Retriever / Mixed Breed (Medium)
Age: Baby
Gender: Female
Color: Brown/Chocolate
Shelter: Hopkins County Humane Society
Phone: (270) 821-8965
Dezzy is a chocolate-colored Lab mix pup with a gentle face and playful energy. She’s looking for a loving home where she can grow, learn, and be part of the family.
👉 Meet Dezzy and apply to adopt on adoptapet
If you’re ready to add a loyal companion to your life, stop by the Hopkins County Humane Society or call (270) 821-8965 to learn more about these adorable pups.
Please note: Pet availability changes quickly. Some pets listed here may have already been adopted or reclaimed, and links may no longer be active. Contact the shelter directly for the most up-to-date information.
